financial_kpis.verdict: Investment Rejection Advised: Critical Section 188 promoter conflict and structural phantom revenue.

red_flags.title: Fictitious / Phantom Revenue Invoicing Without Cleared Bank Cash (EDU-INV-2026-0009)
red_flags.description: Invoice EDU-INV-2026-0009 for ₹15,889,830.51 (+ ₹2,860,169.49 GST) was booked in CA sales and uploaded to GSTR-1, but marked 'UNOFF_SET_UNPAID' on GSTR-3B. Zero customer remittances entered the sovereign bank ledger across 180 days, inflating reported ARR by 57.8%.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Central Goods & Services Tax (CGST) Act 2017 Rule 88C (Tax Discrepancy) & ICAI SA 240 / SA 505 (Auditor Confirmation of Debtors)

red_flags.title: Section 194C / 194J Mandatory TDS Threshold Smurfing
red_flags.description: 25 repetitive disbursements of exactly ₹49,500.00 executed on the same day (totaling ₹12,37,500.00) to TechCloud Advisory LLP. Structured deliberately ₹500 below the statutory ₹50,000 threshold to evade mandatory 10% TDS deduction under Income Tax Act Section 194C/J.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Income Tax Act 1961 Section 194C, Section 194J & Section 271C (100% Penalty for Willful Tax Deduction Failure)

red_flags.title: Aged Trade Receivables > 180 Days (Uncollected Debtor Stagnation)
red_flags.description: CA General Ledger reflects ₹220,000,000.00 in receivables aged over 180 days with zero recovery in the bank ledger. DSO stands stretched at 146.1 days, indicating uncollectible customer revenue.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Companies Act 2013 Schedule III (Trade Receivables Aging Disclosures) & ICAI SA 505 (External Confirmations)
red_flags.counterparty: Trade Receivables Register (Zenith Retail Tech & Affiliates)
